attempts.summary: Joined node1, node2, and node3 into a single RabbitMQ 4.2.7 cluster (Alpine 3.23), created the payments vhost with a durable quorum queue "orders" replicated across all three nodes, and an app_svc application account with full read/write/configure permissions scoped to payments. Verified messages survive the loss of any one node and remain consumable from the remaining nodes. Completed the mandatory native-reboot evidence protocol on all three nodes one at a time, preserving quorum throughout — including diagnosing and fixing a DHCP hostname-override bug that would otherwise have broken RabbitMQ node identity across reboots.
